translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

book.name: Don Sane
book.title: Yohaneŋo Don San Papaine Ea Ra Qelaŋange

content: Yohaneŋo Papia Mane Qeuaŋ Qeuaŋine Tepŋo Makatak Makatakine Kake
Na papia mane qeuaŋ qeuaŋine kawe, ŋei mane ŋei waom seaino met okanmaike, oŋo metine wonŋo malipke metke, metine nat nat ea yemo kibiŋoka qeqine paki, tep sewenŋo makatak makatakine.
So na kawe, aŋelo togogole mane suaineka boka rake, “Ma ŋei koboboineŋo papia tepine ma tipke more, papia qeuaŋ qeuaŋine ea rapokeake?”
Raki siluŋ ŋei mane qeli kotino, me kepe kutno, me seu seu wane kepe qei bano ea ŋineŋo wakone, papia qeuaŋ qeuaŋine ea rapoke kotino kayakane mi ewekke.
Na zok manerop arokkole, yemo onoka wane mida, ŋei mane maratkau oŋo maine maputulake rapokeakane me kotino kayakane rokop mi okange, ea wane arokkole.

Pakiso, ŋei sele eŋano ŋine maneŋo nolale rake, “Mi arokenom. Kanom! Laion mane Yuda wane kominekoune eŋane keuo ŋine wakonge, Dawit wane ŋaboine suaineŋo togogole mage kawali yuange, wane maine eŋe tep sewen ea makokeake paki, papia qeuaŋ qeuaŋine ea siwore rapokeake.”

Pakiso, na lama medeune mane kawe, eŋe ŋei waom sea ea wane keueno okorake, kine kine 4 gegeenerop so ŋei sele edo lolikka okorakoi, lama medeune ea yemo mo qekoi, tanik okorake. Lama eŋe ŋiliwine sewen so deine sewen, ea yemo Anutu wane Asu sewen eŋe mo taleongi, kepe baŋem korop arikoi gemami.
Lama medeune eŋe ariki paki, papia qeuaŋ qeuaŋine, ea ŋei waom seako metke, eŋane metine wongo ŋine make.

Eŋe ea makiso, kine kine 4 gegeenerop so ŋei sele 24 eŋe lama medeunane osino umi qekoi. Eŋe eŋetene weneŋka korop, gita yale, so laseene golŋo mamaine, eao yemo kopu qounerop eaŋo watke metke, ea weneŋ ma metkoi, ea yemo Anutu wane ŋei ŋerep magu eŋane meŋe meŋen.
Eŋe eŋet mane musele iwa yale kitokoi,

content.text: “Goŋo papia manom menageake, so tepine makoke maputulakkene. Ge gekuwi seukkone paki, geŋane seu seu eaŋo ŋei kepe baŋem qoleonnom, Anutu wane biŋek okangoi, ŋei aso baŋem, ea ŋine, donene kine mane, ea ŋine, sola kine kine, ea ŋine, so kepe baŋem, ea ŋine.
Goŋo ware ware urum weku ma ebongone, ea wane pris koune Anutuze qelitine qekei wane, so eŋe kepe kutno maine wareu payake.”

content: Na koso dene manerop potkole, paki aŋelo eŋane don ukatene zok detkole, yemo tausen so milion magune magune eŋane ukatene! Eŋe ŋei waom sea, ea so kine kine 4 gege enerop, ea so ŋei sele ea lolikone okorakoi.
Paki eŋe don suaineka boka rakoi,

content.text: “Lama medeune qeu seukke, eŋe rokouno zonom, riwe morian, dereret, so togole togole, ewe kito kito, kibi maep, so oi bakom maki menaŋ lukmaike!”

content: So na sip qalikap kine kine korop, weti qeli kotino, kepe kutno, so qei kepe bano, so sip qalikap kine kine kiwet koto, so yeye kine kine korop ea wane kotino ge waremami, eŋe detongole, paki eŋe boka orakoi,

content.text: “Ŋei waom seako metmaike, eŋe so lama medeune, eŋano oi bakom, so ewe kito kito, kibi maep, so zonom, eaŋo naso baŋem papa togon banine payake!”

content: Rauso, kine kine 4 gege enerop eŋe rakoi, “Weleka!” Pakiso, ŋei sele eŋe umi ketpi paki meŋenka bakomine kito koi.
